sentences.text: No; for a borrower’s non-compliance with material loan terms, the penalty must be treated as penal charges and must not be levied as penal interest added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.
For default in repayment, the direction says the penalty shall only be levied in the form of penal charges and not penal interest.
The in-force direction also says there shall be no capitalization of penal charges, meaning no further interest is computed on those charges.

missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 provisions on penal charges and the applied rule findings for this Tier 3 UCB.
